# Blond Wayfarer

> > Solo travel guides and itineraries for Europe (Italy, Spain, France) and beyond, with honest advice for anxious and fearful flyers.

Blond Wayfarer is Rachel's travel blog featuring detailed city guides, weekend itineraries, and solo female travel tips across Europe and North America. The site specializes in practical planning advice and mental health support for travelers dealing with flight anxiety and travel envy.

## Key Topics

- Solo travel
- Solo female travel
- Europe travel planning
- Italy (Venice, Verona)
- Spain (Madrid, Seville)
- France (Paris)
- Fear of flying
- Travel anxiety
- Weekend itineraries
- City guides
- Independent travel
- Travel tips
- New York City
- Travel mental health

## Essential Travel Planning Guides

- [Planning A Europe Trip Itinerary (All You Need to Know!)](https://blondwayfarer.com/planning-europe-trip-itinerary): Comprehensive guide to planning Europe trips covering England, Spain & Italy
- [Rachel's New York City Travel Guide](https://blondwayfarer.com/new-york-city-travel-guide): Rachel's comprehensive NYC travel guide hub with museums, shows & itineraries
- [How to Pack for Paris in Fall: Survival Guide Every Visitor Absolutely Needs](https://blondwayfarer.com/paris-packing-list-fall): Fall packing list for Paris with essentials and World Nomads insurance tips

## Italy Travel Guides

- [Solo Travel in Venice: Everything You Need to Know](https://blondwayfarer.com/solo-travel-venice-guide): Complete solo travel guide to Venice, Italy with tips for Murano & Burano
- [2 days in Verona Itinerary: The Best Things to See & Do](https://blondwayfarer.com/2-days-verona-itinerary): Weekend itinerary for Verona, Italy featuring Romeo & Juliet sites

## Spain Travel Guides

- [Is Madrid Worth Visiting? An Honest Guide to Spain's Capital](https://blondwayfarer.com/is-madrid-worth-visiting): Honest review of Madrid with Prado Museum and art highlights by Goya
- [2 Days in Seville Itinerary: What to See and Do in a Weekend](https://blondwayfarer.com/2-days-in-seville-itinerary): Weekend itinerary for Seville, Andalusia's largest city in Spain
- [5 Reasons You Need to Visit Madrid in April](https://blondwayfarer.com/reasons-visit-madrid-april): Spring travel guide for Madrid in April with Easter celebrations

## Solo Female Travel & Safety

- [Is Paris Safe for Solo Female Travellers? My Honest Opinion](https://blondwayfarer.com/paris-safe-solo-female-travellers): Safety tips and honest review for solo female travelers visiting Paris

## Travel Anxiety & Mental Health

- [Anxious People Can Travel Too (And Here's How!)](https://blondwayfarer.com/anxious-people-travel-advice): Travel advice for anxious travelers managing fear of flying and anxiety
- [The Flight that Made Me Terrified of Flying](https://blondwayfarer.com/flight-terrified-fly): Personal story about flight trauma and developing fear of flying in Italy
- [6 Things Fearful Flyers Hate Hearing](https://blondwayfarer.com/things-fearful-flyers-hate-hearing): Aviation phobia advice on common unhelpful comments fearful flyers hear
- [5 Secrets To Destroy Travel Envy](https://blondwayfarer.com/secrets-destroying-travel-envy): Mental health advice on overcoming travel jealousy and social media envy

## More European Destinations
